summary: Backend-only testing for BIR Filipino Filing SaaS. Created comprehensive pytest suite (30 tests) covering auth (register/login/me/logout/protected), business profile + onboarding, BIR engine (1701Q 8% flat, 1701Q graduated TRAIN brackets, 2551Q gating + 3% math), filing history & mark-submitted, deadlines per classification, AI Claude Sonnet 4.5 chat, admin metrics/rules/RBAC, and mock billing. All 30 tests passed (100% success rate).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py uses bcrypt directly (good, hash starts with $2b$) and httpOnly cookies with samesite=none secure=true — correctly configured for cross-site preview.
server.py seed_admin idempotent: updates password if changed and ensures admin role — good.

CORS: when FRONTEND_URL is set, allow_origins is restricted to a single origin which is required for allow_credentials=True. Currently FRONTEND_URL points to a different host (8d9e0af4-...) than the active preview (bir-filer.preview.emergentagent.com). Browser-based credentialed requests from the active frontend host could fail CORS. Recommend updating FRONTEND_URL in /app/backend/.env to match the active frontend origin, or supporting a list of allowed origins.
bir_engine.py: 8% flat math is correct: max(0, gross_sales+other_income-250000)*0.08. Graduated TRAIN brackets verified (600k → 62500). Cleanly fed by admin-editable bir_rules collection.
forms.py: 2551Q gating correctly rejects 8% flat OR VAT-registered with HTTP 400.
deadlines.py: Correctly emits 2551Q only for graduated non-VAT; 1701Q Q1/Q2/Q3 for all; 2551Q Q4 due Jan 25 next year — verified.
ai_assistant.py: Uses claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 via emergentintegrations. Returns Filipino BIR-context response in <60s. Working.
billing.py: cleanly structured for PayMongo swap (provider field, redirect_url placeholder) — labeled MOCK clearly.
Minor: routes/admin.py imports `BirRule` but never uses it — unused import.
Minor: routes/billing.py imports os, uuid, HTTPException without using them in critical paths — unused imports.
Minor: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI on_event handlers (consider lifespan) but functional.
Minor: business profile POST does not validate TIN format (9–14 digits) — acceptable for MVP per code comment.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@birfilipino.app / Admin@2026 (auto-seeded, verified working). Test users created with TEST_*@example.com prefix.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users with random UUIDs each run (flat freelancer & graduated freelancer). Admin user seeded by app on startup. No cleanup performed — TEST_ prefix used for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully working at https://bir-filer.preview.emergentagent.com. All 30 backend tests pass. AI chat works (~5–8s response). Admin login: admin@birfilipino.app / Admin@2026. Note: backend/.env FRONTEND_URL is set to a stale URL (8d9e0af4-...preview...) that differs from the active frontend host (bir-filer.preview.emergentagent.com). This restricts CORS allow_origins. If frontend integration testing fails with CORS error, fix FRONTEND_URL in backend/.env first. Mocked: billing/checkout (provider=mock), email_service (no-op without RESEND_API_KEY).
